resources.string: Timed single- or multi-touch tests with per-second trends, CPS, history and result sharing.
Choose a duration and mode, arm the test, then press the test area to begin. The first press counts. Holding or dragging does not repeat.
Tap the area to start timing
Interrupted. This session is not added to history
Limit of 10000 reached. Ended early; no complete result saved
Touch best CPS for this duration and mode
Tap trend. Total: %1$d. Peak one-second count: %2$d.
Horizontal: seconds since start. Vertical: taps in that second. The current second may be incomplete. Peak uses fixed one-second bins.
Keeps complete tests up to a history limit of %1$d. Touch bests compare touch-only results with the same duration and mode.
Permanently clear all tap-speed history on this device? Current results will remain visible.
End this session and discard its tap data? Saved history will remain.
Cannot read history. Retry or confirm clearing it to recover.
Results have not been saved. Retry; you can still copy or share them.
History could not be cleared. Please retry.

CPS means taps per second. Final average = taps ÷ selected seconds. The live average uses a minimum denominator of one second. Each press counts once; the deadline and later inputs are excluded. Single-touch mode requires all fingers to lift before another press; multi-touch counts fingers separately. Locking, backgrounding or rotating interrupts the test. Keyboard, accessibility and touch results are not directly comparable. No auto-clicking or population rankings.
